turbidity_proxy.source: reach's own OK Sentinel-2 turbidity index observations in the same meteorological season, fitting period only

ndci.source: reach's own OK Sentinel-2 NDCI observations in the same meteorological season, fitting period only

not_computed.lead_time_distribution: needs issued alerts scored against incidents.
not_computed.false_alarm_rate_after_guardrails: the guardrails exist (engine/alerts.py) but have not been replayed over the walk-forward period; the pre-guardrail operating point is under probability.operating_point_pre_guardrail.

production_calibration.note: fold metrics above are the RAW model; the forecasts table, alerts and API use the calibrated intervals (coverage below, test = held out)

head_to_head.weather_label: hindcast with observed weather - upper bound on live skill
notes: LightGBM's test fit is retrained on data through 2024 (walk-forward); the EA-LSTM is trained on 2016-2023 only (2024 = early stopping), so on test LightGBM has one more year of training data.
Spatial holdout: the EA-LSTM never saw these reaches; LightGBM variant A was trained on them (reach_id feature) - not a like-for-like comparison.
seasonal_naive is a point forecast: no interval, no calibration, CRPS = MAE.

gate.rule: ealstm+assim beats lightgbm+assim on validation CRPS in >= 2 of 3 buckets for every target, with |coverage_80 - 0.80| no worse (+0.0)

unassimilated_comparison.rule: ealstm beats lightgbm on validation CRPS in >= 2 of 3 buckets for every target, with |coverage_80 - 0.80| no worse (+0.0)

attribution_sanity.status: not computed: EA-LSTM is not production (SHAP from LightGBM is served)

verdicts: WRONG SIGN: LightGBM B.production lowers turbidity on 62% of reaches when imperviousness rises
WRONG SIGN: LightGBM A.production lowers turbidity on 75% of reaches when imperviousness rises
WRONG SIGN: EA-LSTM lowers turbidity on 64% of reaches when imperviousness rises
